name: long-analysis
description: Long input with related files. Expected: cheap_first, premium tier due to high complexity.

request.userInput: Analyze the following module hierarchy and propose a refactor plan. Pay attention to cyclic imports between the auth, user, and session packages, and consider backward compatibility for external integrators. Include a migration sequence that can be applied in stages without downtime.

relatedFiles.content:
import { Session } from '../session';
export class User { constructor(public id: string, public session?: Session) {} }

import { User } from '../user';
export class Session { constructor(public user: User) {} }
